info.title: orcai
info.description: A CLI tool for managing GitHub Projects and Copilot-assigned issues in bulk. Define your project in a YAML file and let orcai create issues, assign them to Copilot, and clean up when done.

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Configure authentication for OrcAI.

commands.name: app
commands.description: Authenticate with a GitHub App.

options.name: --app-id
options.description: GitHub App ID.

options.name: --key
options.description: Path to the GitHub App private key file.

options.name: --installation-id
options.description:
GitHub App installation ID for the target
organisation.
help                  display this list of options.

commands.name: create-app
commands.description:
Register a new GitHub App via the manifest flow and
store its credentials.

options.name: --app-name
options.description:
Name of the GitHub App to register. Defaults to
'orcai-<org>-gh-app' when --org is supplied. Required
if --org is not supplied.

options.name: --org
options.description:
Register the app under an organisation instead of
your personal account. Required if --app-name is not
supplied.

options.name: --port
options.description:
Local callback port for the OAuth redirect (default:
9876).
help                  display this list of options.

commands.name: generate
commands.description:
Generate a YAML job config from a name, org, and
optional repo list.

options.name: --name
options.description:
Job name (used as project title and issue title).
Required unless --interactive.

options.name: --org
options.description: GitHub organisation. Required unless --interactive.

options.name: --repo
options.description:
Repo short-name to include (repeatable, e.g. --repo
my-repo). Optional.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output YAML file path. Defaults to <slug>.yml in the
current directory.

options.name: --interactive
options.description:
Prompt for any missing values and select repos via an
interactive TUI.

options.name: --provider
options.description:
(default). Omit for github.

commands.name: notify
commands.description: Post a comment to issues and/or PRs in the lock file.

options.name: --dryrun
options.description:
Preview which items would be notified without posting
any comments.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose output.

options.name: --target
options.description:
Which lock file items to notify: issues (default),
prs, or both.

options.name: --state
options.description:
Filter by current GitHub state: open (default),
closed, or all.

options.name: --template
options.description: YAML. Supports {key} placeholders.

options.name: --data
options.description:
Extra template variable as key=value (repeatable).
E.g. --data sprint=42.

options.name: --json-data
options.description:
Extra template variables as a JSON object string.
E.g. --json-data '{"sprint":"42"}'. Merged with
--data; --data takes precedence on key conflicts.
help                  display this list of options.

commands.name: nudge
commands.description:
Re-trigger @copilot on issues that have no pull
request yet.

options.name: --dryrun
options.description:
Preview which issues would be nudged without making
any changes.

options.name: --save-lock
options.description: Write discovered PRs back to the lock file.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose output.

options.name: --max-concurrency
options.description:
(default: 4). Note: high values may hit GitHub rate
limits.

options.name: --on-closed-pr
options.description:
What to do when a closed (unmerged) PR already
exists: skip (default), nudge, or fail.
help                  display this list of options.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Execute a job defined in a YAML configuration file.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose output.

options.name: --auto-create-labels
options.description:
Create any labels that don't exist in a repo before
adding them to issues.

options.name: --skip-lock
options.description:
Bypass the lock file and always fetch live state from
GitHub.

options.name: --max-concurrency
options.description:
(default: 4). Note: high values may hit GitHub rate
limits.

options.name: --no-parallel
options.description:
Disable all parallelism — files are processed
sequentially and repo checks within each file run
sequentially. Overrides --max-concurrency.

options.name: --continue-on-error
options.description:
Continue processing remaining files when one fails,
instead of stopping on the first error.

options.name: --on-closed-issue
options.description:
What to do when a closed issue with a matching title
is found: create (default), reopen, skip, or fail.

options.name: --dryrun
options.description:
Preview what would be created/updated without making
any GitHub API calls or writing the lock file.

options.name: --json
options.description:
Emit machine-readable JSON output to stdout.
help                  display this list of options.

commands.name: validate
commands.description:
Validate a YAML job config and verify all repos are
accessible.

options.name: --no-parallel
options.description:
Check repositories sequentially instead of in
parallel.

options.name: --max-concurrency
options.description: (default: 4).

options.name: --continue-on-error
options.description: Continue validating remaining files when one fails.

options.name: --skip-lock
options.description:
Bypass the lock file and check all repos live (slow;
use to force a full re-check).

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print each repository check result as it completes.

options.name: --json
options.description:
Emit machine-readable JSON output to stdout.
help                  display this list of options.
